name: Staffing & Talent Health
question: Is the company attracting, keeping, and productively using the people it needs — especially in the functions its strategy depends on?

signals.description: Headcount level (point-in-time) + reported changes; company entity workforce.total (weekly refresh) + layoffs/hiring news monitors
Executive departures/arrivals, especially CFO/CTO/COO. Webset of person entities (leadership roster) with refresh monitor + 1d news monitor; profile refresh is weekly, the news path is faster.

recipe.query_template: {company} CFO OR CTO OR COO departure OR resignation OR appointment

signals.description: Key-function hiring intensity (e.g., AI researchers, field sales); category:"people" searches on role + company
Glassdoor-style morale coverage in press (no direct ratings API — evidence gap noted)

recipe.query_template: {company} employee morale OR workplace culture OR Glassdoor
{company} strike OR union action OR labor dispute

signals.description: Founder/insider commitment vs departures-and-selling pattern; news + filings coverage

recipe.query_template: {company} founder OR insider departure OR share selling

grade_anchors.A: Net senior talent inflow in strategy-critical functions; stable executive bench; labor relations quiet.
grade_anchors.C: Normal churn; one unexplained senior exit; hiring slowed but targeted.
grade_anchors.F: CFO/auditor exits in close succession, exodus in the function the strategy depends on, or sustained hiring freeze contradicting growth narrative.

false_signals.description: "Performance management," contractor purges, silent attrition without announcement. Severance/attrition coverage + workforce.total deltas vs company statements.

recipe.query_template: {company} performance management OR contractor cuts OR silent attrition OR severance

false_signals.description: Mass promotions replacing compensation. Weak signal; only flagged when corroborated.

recipe.query_template: {company} mass promotions OR title inflation instead of raises

false_signals.description: Job postings maintained for optics without hires (postings data is an evidence gap in v1; inferred only from reporting).

recipe.query_template: {company} ghost jobs OR job postings without hiring

evidence_policy.notes: Job-postings data and direct employer-ratings APIs are v1 evidence gaps; morale and ghost hiring are inferred from press coverage only — disclose this gap.
